fields.summary_ko.0: A $1,000 investment in Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA, BRKB) 20 years ago is now worth $8,310, achieving a 732% return (11.16% annually), outperforming the S&P 500's 10.6%.
fields.summary_ko.1: BRKA rose from $71.29 in November 2006 to approximately $590 currently, with over 50 years of consecutive dividend increases and a diversified portfolio supporting long-term growth expectations.
